cwe_content.cwe: CWE-200,Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

candidate.Reason: The method directly appends all extra parameters from user input to the JDBC URL without any validation or blacklisting. This allows attackers to inject malicious parameters like 'allowLoadLocalInfile=true' which enables arbitrary local file read access when connecting to a rogue MySQL server.
The constructor accepts and stores user-provided extraParams without validation, allowing attackers to supply malicious JDBC parameters that will be directly included in the connection URL.

The code directly appends all extra parameters from user input to the JDBC URL without validation, allowing dangerous parameters like 'allowLoadLocalInfile=true' to be injected, which enables arbitrary local file read attacks when connecting to a malicious MySQL server.

This line executes the JDBC connection using the potentially malicious URL containing unvalidated parameters, directly enabling the vulnerability by establishing a connection that could include dangerous MySQL parameters.

The code constructs a JDBC connection URL with user-provided parameters (extraParams) without filtering dangerous MySQL parameters like 'allowLoadLocalInfile'. An attacker could inject this parameter to enable local file reading capabilities when connecting to a malicious MySQL server.

User-controlled extraParams are directly concatenated into the JDBC URL without any security validation or blacklisting of dangerous MySQL parameters, allowing injection of malicious parameters like 'allowLoadLocalInfile=true'.
The ConnectMessage constructor adds timeout parameters to extraParams without validating existing user-provided parameters, potentially allowing parameter injection if user input is processed first.
